steps.value: PRACTICE 1 OF 1 · FORCE-LAWAn ideal horizontal oscillator has m = 1 kg, k = 4 N/m and b = 2 N·s/m. At one instant x = +0.25 m and v = −0.50 m/s. What is its acceleration?Recall the explanation. Choose the best answer once more.This retry is recorded separately from your first try and model estimates.A+1 m/s²B−2 m/s²C0 m/s²D+2 m/s²That connection holds on retry.Correct answer: 0 m/s²The spring contributes −kx = −1 N. The damper contributes −bv = +1 N because the mass moves left. The net force and instantaneous acceleration are zero. The nonzero velocity means the mass is not at rest.Apply the idea: Change only v to +0.50 m/s and calculate the new acceleration.See practice results →Back to learning trace
